title: Strong Complementarity
body_html:
Strong Complementarity

There exists an optimal pair $(x^*,y^*) \in X(A)\times Y(A)$ such that a pure row has positive probability under $x^*$ if and only if it is a best response to $y^*$, and a pure column has positive probability under $y^*$ if and only if it is a best response to $x^*$.
